description: Expose an OpenShift resource (service, deployment, etc.) with secure route endpoints supporting SSL/TLS termination

annotations.description: Annotations to apply to the route in KEY=VALUE format

destinationCaCertificate.description: Path to destination CA certificate file (for reencrypt)

dryRun.description: Show what would be created without actually creating it

insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy.description: Policy for insecure traffic: None (reject), Allow (allow), Redirect (redirect to secure)

key.description: Path to TLS private key file

labels.description: Labels to apply to the route in KEY=VALUE format

name.description: Name of the resource to expose

port.description: Target port to expose (port name or number)

resourceType.description: Resource type to expose (service, deploymentconfig, deployment)

routeName.description: Name for the route (if not specified, derives from resource name)

routeType.description: Type of secure route: edge (SSL termination at router), passthrough (SSL passthrough), reencrypt (SSL re-encryption)

tlsTermination.description: TLS termination type (deprecated, use routeType instead)

name: oc_expose
